info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Configuration Deletions API
info.description: The Manage Configuration Deletions API allows users to remove specific configurations from the system by their unique identifier. This operation is critical for maintaining an up-to-date configuration set, ensuring obsolete or unwanted configurations are no longer available. Typical consumers of this API include system administrators and automated processes that manage configurations across environments. The API facilitates streamlined configuration management, enhancing overall system performance and reliability.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to delete the configuration resource identified by RES-100045 from the system, ensuring that it is permanently removed and cannot be accessed thereafter.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details needed to delete the configuration resource identified by RES-100045. It should include the necessary parameters or identifiers to process the deletion request.

204.description: The resource was successfully deleted with no additional content returned.

DeleteConfigurationRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation on the configurations resource.

DeleteConfigurationRes100045Response_204.description: This schema represents the response type for a successful delete operation, conforming to the application/json media type.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication mechanism. Clients must include a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header when making requests. This token is typically issued by the authentication server and serves to validate the identity and permissions of the user.
